title: Arsenic in wells
intro:
Illustrative data, made up for this book. Arsenic (µg/L) in 20 private wells chosen at random in one county. The drinking-water limit is 10 µg/L. Fit a lognormal distribution.

Give the fitted μ and σ of ln(arsenic) (four decimals) and the estimated share of all the county's wells over the limit, P(X > 10) (four decimals).

In the Workbench: **Continuous distribution**, **Lognormal**, **Fitted to a data column**, **Value of interest** 10.

MoreThan.says: That is the share under the limit. The question asks for the share over it, P(X > 10).

hints: Take ln of each value; μ and σ are their mean and standard deviation.
